rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [MANDATORY_CONDITION] gen:IMO009BergyWatersShape/sh:property[nltl:iceCondition]: The candidate imposes sh:minCount 1 on iceCondition for every ship, but the requirement only specifies a conditional constraint when ice_condition equals 'bergy waters' and does not make ice_condition universally mandatory. Required change: Remove sh:minCount 1 from the iceCondition property constraint, or otherwise scope that mandatory requirement to an authoritative obligation that is explicitly part of IMO-009.

[DATATYPE] MainShape sh:sparql constraints for landOriginIceConcentration and totalIceConcentration: Both constraints require qudt:numericValue to have exactly datatype xsd:decimal, but the requirement and canonical quantity terms do not mandate decimal encoding. Valid numeric values such as xsd:integer 1 can therefore be rejected, including a boundary value that must satisfy the total-concentration condition. Required change: Remove the exact xsd:decimal datatype test or replace it with a numeric-datatype-compatible check that accepts all valid numeric quantity values while preserving the stated thresholds.
